title: Applicationevent accesses Dataobject
description: The application event carries the data object as its payload, so the event cannot be emitted or interpreted without it: a domain object that keeps its own state consistent, or a payload with no declared shape. Use accesses to a data-model object schema instead when the payload is held to a declared shape: an interface, record or struct of only fields, or an Avro or JSON schema definition.
x-dr-evidence: The event class declares as its payload field a domain object (a value object or aggregate with methods on its own fields), or the payload is typed any, object, dict or Map<string, unknown>, or is a parsed JSON value, with no interface, type or schema declaring its fields.
